meta.name: Send tailored Upwork job proposals with Gemini, Slack, Gmail, Drive and ClickUp

name: AI Upwork Auto-Proposal – Monitor Jobs, Match Candidates & Send Bids via Gmail + ClickUp

parameters.content:
## 📤 Upwork Auto-Proposal Generator – AI-Powered Bid Automation

### How it works
Every 2 minutes, the workflow reads the `#upwork-jobs` Slack channel where new job posts are forwarded. A deduplication code node filters out jobs already processed using n8n's static workflow data. If new jobs are found, three parallel branches prepare the context: candidate resumes are listed from Google Drive, downloaded, and text-extracted; the company deck link is fetched from Drive. All three streams merge and a Gemini 2.5 Flash prompt is built with the job description, candidate profiles, and deck link. Gemini returns a JSON array of tailored proposals — one per candidate per job. Each proposal is emailed via Gmail, posted to `#upwork-proposal` on Slack, and split into individual ClickUp tasks for tracking. If Gemini returns no proposals, a manual review flag is posted to Slack.

### Setup steps
1. Connect **Slack OAuth2** to all three Slack nodes and set `YOUR_UPWORK_JOBS_CHANNEL_ID` and `YOUR_UPWORK_PROPOSAL_CHANNEL_ID`.
2. Connect **Google Drive OAuth2** to the two Drive API nodes — set the correct folder IDs for resumes and the company deck.
3. Connect **Google Gemini API** to the Gemini HTTP node.
4. Connect **Gmail OAuth2** and update the recipient list in `Gmail: Send Proposals`.
5. Connect **ClickUp** and set `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_UPWORK_PROPOSALS_LIST_ID` in the ClickUp task node.
6. Activate the schedule trigger.

## 📡 Job Discovery & Deduplication
Polls `#upwork-jobs` every 2 minutes. Filters messages already processed using n8n's persistent static workflow data — so each job is only ever handled once, even across multiple runs.

## 📄 Resume & Deck Context Fetch
Three parallel branches run when new jobs are found: lists and downloads candidate resume PDFs from Google Drive, extracts the text from each PDF, and fetches the company deck link — all merged before the AI prompt is built.

## 🤖 AI Proposal Generation
Builds a structured Gemini prompt with the job post, all candidate profiles (name, resume text, Drive link), and the company deck. Gemini 2.5 Flash returns a JSON array of tailored proposals. The response is parsed and validated before routing.

## 📣 Proposal Delivery & Task Creation
Valid proposals are dispatched via three parallel outputs: a Gmail summary to the BD team, a Slack post to `#upwork-proposal`, and individual ClickUp tasks (one per proposal) for tracking. No proposals → a Slack manual review flag fires instead.

## 🔑 Credentials Required
- **Slack OAuth2** — job history + proposal post + flag alert
- **Google Drive OAuth2** — resume listing + download + deck fetch
- **Google Gemini API** — proposal generation
- **Gmail OAuth2** — BD team notification email
- **ClickUp** — proposal task creation

Never hardcode personal emails or channel IDs in shared templates.

nodes.name: Schedule: Every 2 Min
nodes.notes: Polls frequently instead of hourly so proposals go out within ~2 min of a job being posted, without needing a Slack Events App.

nodes.name: Slack: Get #your-upwork-jobs-channel History
nodes.notes: Uses conversations.history (channels:history scope) instead of search, which is the right Slack API for 'recent messages in this channel'. Set the real channel ID in channelId.value.

nodes.name: Code: Filter New Jobs (Dedup)
nodes.notes: Replaces the old dead-end filter node. Tracks the last-seen Slack timestamp so the same job never gets a duplicate proposal.

nodes.name: Drive: List Resume Files (API)
nodes.notes: Calls the Drive API directly instead of using the Google Drive node's Search operation, whose 'Search File/Folder Name' method only accepts a plain name and ignores raw Drive query syntax. This always behaves the same regardless of n8n version.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: '1y1Zy9pClWEjFR2VOMrQnCllFVDxgedua' in parents and mimeType='application/pdf' and trashed=false

nodes.name: Drive: Download Each Resume
nodes.notes: Runs once per file from the previous node. Downloads the actual PDF bytes so we can extract real text, not just match on filename.

nodes.name: Extract Text From Resume PDF
nodes.notes: This is the key fix: the old workflow never read resume content, it just matched filenames against a hardcoded list. Now the AI sees real skills/projects from each PDF.

nodes.name: Code: Attach Name + Link to Text
Drive: Find Company Deck (API)
nodes.notes: Direct Drive API call, same reasoning as the resume list fix. Edit the 'Techdome Deck' text in the q parameter to match your actual deck's filename.

nodes.name: Merge: Jobs + Profiles + Deck
nodes.notes: IMPORTANT: this node needs 3 inputs (jobs data, resume profiles, deck link). If it only shows 2 input handles after import, open Settings on this node and set 'Number of Inputs' to 3 manually, then reconnect the 3rd branch (Code: Pick Deck Link) to input 2.

nodes.name: Code: Build AI Prompt
nodes.notes: Now feeds the model real resume excerpts per candidate instead of just a filename match, and includes the deck link so it can be referenced.

nodes.name: Slack: Flag Manual Review
nodes.notes: New. The old workflow silently did nothing on the false branch of IF: Has Proposals (both outputs went to the same Gmail node). Now a failed/parse-error/skip-only batch actually surfaces to the team.

main.node: Code: Attach Name + Link to Text
